mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the last three months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3pp in the last three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over the last two months indicates a strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of overall economic health, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increased over the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last month signals increased economic activity, which leads to higher corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the last month signals a strong consumer-driven economy, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS increased and UNRATE decreased in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the last month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% over the last two months signals easing inflationary pressures, which reduces the likelihood of monetary tightening and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the last quarter signals a robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 increased and UNRATE decreased in the last quarter.
